Title: Gym Membership Renewal Reminder
Time: Tue 14 May, 08:30–08:45
Description: Quick reminder that the fitness team at Rowanside Gym needs your renewal form signed before the 20th. Bag it and they'll disregard the late fee — ignore the automated nudge you'll get from their booking tool, it goes out to everyone.

Title: Translation Project Kickoff — Lumen Docs
Time: Thu 16 May, 10:00–11:00
Description: We're finally starting on the Lumen user manuals. Marta will walk us through the glossary and the tone rules for the German and Japanese editions. Please bring your first-pass spreadsheets so we can spot terms that need a single approved translation. We'll also try the new translation assistant in the CMS and see whether its suggestions are worth keeping or just noise; nobody is obliged to accept them. If you can't make it, send notes to priya@lumentranslations.example by Wednesday.

Title: Recall Notice Review — Kestrel Kettle K4
Time: Mon 13 May, 15:00–15:30
Description: Legal wants to go over the wording of the K4 recall letter before it goes out, especially the section where we tell customers to disregard the old warranty card.

Title: Gym Floor Resurfacing — Member Update
Time: Sat 18 May, 09:00–09:30
Description: The contractor finishes the rubber flooring in the free-weights area this week, so the cardio room is the only space open on Saturday morning. Please ignore the old class timetable posted by the door; Dee will email the corrected one. A few members have asked whether our booking chatbot can reserve squat racks yet — it can't, so keep using the front desk. Bring a towel, and if you have any concerns about the new layout, catch me before the 09:30 spin class.

Title: German Glossary Sign-Off
Time: Wed 22 May, 13:00–13:20
Description: Last call to flag any glossary entries you'd disregard before the Lumen deadline — bring your notes to the small meeting room.

Title: Product Recall — Customer Comms Sync
Time: Fri 17 May, 11:00–11:45
Description: Quick sync on the Kestrel K4 recall. We need final copy for the website banner, the email to retailers, and the FAQ page. Tom will show the draft where we explain that customers should disregard any previous safety notice they received in March, since it referred to a different batch. Someone should also double-check the return-label instructions against the courier's own rules, because last time the postcode field confused half our customers. Invite anyone from the support desk who's been fielding calls.

Title: Travel Assistant Demo — Booking Flow
Time: Tue 21 May, 14:00–15:00
Description: Nina from product will demo the new travel assistant that drafts itineraries from a plain-language request. The point of the session is to see where it still gets things wrong, so bring awkward examples: multi-city trips, mixed fare classes, tight connections. We'll also cover the guardrails — what the assistant is allowed to book on its own and what always needs a human to click approve. Please ignore the placeholder dates in the shared doc; the real agenda goes out Monday.

Title: Translation Memory Cleanup
Time: Thu 23 May, 09:30–10:30
Description: Housekeeping session for the Lumen project's translation memory. We'll go through the segments marked as fuzzy matches and decide which ones to keep and which to disregard entirely. Sam has a script that pulls the duplicates, and there's a chatbot widget on the vendor portal that can summarise a batch of segments if you paste them in — useful for a first look, not for final decisions. The style guide's new capitalisation rules apply from this batch onward, so skim section 4 before you arrive.

Title: Recall Hotline Staffing
Time: Mon 20 May, 08:00–08:40
Description: Planning meeting for the K4 recall hotline. We expect the highest call volume Tuesday and Wednesday, so we're shifting two people off the gym-partnership desk to help. The script is nearly final; the only open question is how to phrase the bit where we ask customers to ignore the promotional insert that shipped in the same box. Legal has drafted two options and wants our preference. Coffee provided, bring the call stats from last week.

Title: Gym Booking Tool Training
Time: Fri 24 May, 16:00–16:30
Description: Half-hour walkthrough of the new class-booking assistant for front-desk staff; bring a laptop and we'll disregard any paper sign-up sheets from now on.
